content.text: Submitted (status remains **missing**, preferred level). The only change in this pass was aligning the temporal anchor to the checklist wording — "Upon expiry or termination" and "within 30 days after such expiry or termination" — so the 30-day return trigger reads literally against expiry or termination. All other preferred elements (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, standard machine-readable format, deletion and written certification after return) are unchanged, and no existing sentence of Sections 13–14 is touched.
